title: A Songbook for the Summer
author: Elodie Vasquez
blurb: Vesper Sandoval, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
